d:
Lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath puja ke sanpann hone ke bad ab desh-videsh men rah rahe apnon tak chhathi maiya ka prasad pahunchane ki kavayad tej ho gaee hai. chhath ke char din bad bhi mujaphpharpur pradhan dakghar men prasad bhejne valon ki bhir umar rahi hai. dak vibhag ki or se banae gae vishesh kauntar par lagatar log chhath ka prasad buk kara rahe hain, jahan pratidin karib 50 se 100 parsal ki buking ho rahi hai.
